population.span: Hospitalized patients were eligible for the trial if they had clinically suspected or laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and no medical history that might, in the opinion of the attending clinician, put patients at substantial risk if they were to participate in the trial.

estimate.span: Overall, 482 patients (22.9%) in the dexamethasone group and 1110 patients (25.7%) in the usual care group died within 28 days after randomization (age-adjusted rate ratio, 0.83; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.75 to 0.93; P<0.001).

ci.span: Overall, 482 patients (22.9%) in the dexamethasone group and 1110 patients (25.7%) in the usual care group died within 28 days after randomization (age-adjusted rate ratio, 0.83; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.75 to 0.93; P<0.001).

analysis_set.span: All analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle.

treatment_strategy.span: Eligible and consenting patients were assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive either the usual standard of care alone or the usual standard of care plus oral or intravenous dexamethasone (at a dose of 6 mg once daily) for up to 10 days (or until hospital discharge if sooner)

follow_up.span: Overall, 482 patients (22.9%) in the dexamethasone group and 1110 patients (25.7%) in the usual care group died within 28 days after randomization

served_mismatch: The served estimate and confidence interval match the source for overall intention-to-treat 28-day mortality. However, the source reports an age-adjusted rate ratio, not an odds ratio as specified by served_outcome.estimand; RR must not be interpreted as a risk ratio here.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Hospitalized patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 were eligible, but eligibility was not restricted to adults throughout recruitment.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Initially, recruitment was limited to patients who were at least 18 years of age, but the age limit was removed starting on May 9, 2020.

notes: RR denotes the source's age-adjusted rate ratio. All spans use the held full text, which is the preliminary report. No numerical candidate was rejected; the served numbers match.
